description: Uchumi Supermarkets Limited is a Kenya-based company engaged in the retail supermarkets operation. It distributes bakery, wines, meat, fish, vegetables, as well as kitchen appliances and decoration, among others. The Company operates a network of 15 branches locally. Uchumi Supermarkets Limited's subsidiaries include wholly owned Uchumi Supermarkets (Uganda) Limited and Kasarani Mall Limited.
address: Yarrow Road, Off Nanyuki Road, P.O. Box 73167-00200, Nairobi, Kenya
